text.description_html:
Acorn WI1BP, 22 Inch Warwick Forest Tip Dummy Strap Hinge

This decorative dummy strap hinge is a great way to add rustic charm to any door without the need of installing actual hinges. The Forest Tip Warwick 22 Inch Dummy Strap Hinge can change the look of your doors without having to reinstall all the existing hardware or for when working hinges would be inoperable like on a garage door. The 22 Inch Warwick Forest Tip Dummy Strap Hinge has a rough black iron finish that duplicates the texture found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals. Good for interior and exterior doors, the Acorn made Forest Tip Dummy Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Also Available 19 Inch Forest Dummy Strap Door Hinge

Click Here to see the entire Acorn Warwick Tip Collection

Specifications of the Acorn Rough Iron Forest Tip Dummy Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 22"
  • Max Width: 3-3/4"
  • Width at hinge: 1-3/4"
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
